title: UNVERIFIED — Rooms Along the Road

features.name: a room key, and one for the front door
features.desc-on-touch: A man at the bar says he will be on his own upstairs. He has paid for one bed and is being trusted with the building.

features.name: a telephone, ringing on the desk
features.desc-on-touch: Nobody at reception. A note asks him to ring a number. While he waits for an answer the telephone in front of him starts ringing, which he picks up to book himself in.

features.name: a billiard table beneath a fitted cover
features.desc-on-touch: In a room with curtains hung before Federation. Trick shots for an audience of ghosts, otherwise silent amidst the hay and gravel and stars. One ball pads and then clicks another.

features.name: a bath large enough to dress a wedding party
features.desc-on-touch: When the plug is pulled, the water can be heard moving through the hotel beneath.

features.name: the rooftop parapets
features.desc-on-touch: Leaned on with a tumbler of water. The nation starts and finishes at the hotel's back fence. Pastures the colour of absence. The wind is heard before it rises.

inscription: I have not finished with the balcony
